propositions.A_exactness: common U ⇒ comonotone ⇒ VaR of sum = sum of VaR (theorem, not approximation)
propositions.B_bound_discipline: only ES/CVaR has the comonotone upper bound; VaR is not subadditive so r95 must NOT be claimed as a dependence-robust bound; union bound needs per-step alpha ~99% for H=5 overall 95%
